pinned_api_basis.finding: App::logic runs before visible UI and may also run while hidden after repaint requests; it may not paint or show UI.
Root update calls App::logic unconditionally, then gates App::update and App::ui on is_visible.
request_repaint_after schedules a repaint of the current viewport, supporting a bounded hidden poll cadence.

review.hidden_state_polls: Pass: poll_session, poll_failed_cleanup, poll_lifecycle_actions, and drain_app_requests each have one call site, all in logic.
review.hidden_close_stop_quit_restore: Pass: the existing close latch, CancelClose, failed-cleanup visibility, Stop/Quit acknowledgment, minimize-to-tray, and restore frame latch are moved into logic and use only context viewport commands/state updates.
review.rendering_and_script_state: Pass: page sizing, appearance sync, script fields/profile snapshots, and every panel/layout remain in visible ui; raw_input_hook remains separate.
review.capture_and_disconnect_refresh: Pass: bounded capture queue draining and periodic device/target/monitor refresh move with logic; refresh mutates cached state and requests Stop on assigned-device loss, with no UI painting or OS pointer/input injection.
review.duplicate_polling: Pass: source search finds one call site for each moved poll/drain and one capture-event drain.
